description: This file defines Pydantic data models for a gym management system, including schemas for exercise logs and body metrics, used for creating and outputting data related to user fitness tracking.

classes.name: ExerciseLogCreate
classes.description: Payload to create a new exercise log for the current user.

classes.name: BodyMetricsCreate
classes.description: Payload to create a body metrics snapshot for the current user.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Pydantic configuration class enabling ORM mode for ExerciseLogOut and BodyMetricsOut.
